remarks: Welcome to Soundview Towers, one of Stamford's premier luxury high-rises! This spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style.  Located just minutes from downtown Stamford, I-95, and an array of shopping and dining options, this condo is extremely well situated for easy access to everything you need. Step outside your door and enjoy a short stroll to the vibrant restaurants on Bedford Street. Inside, you'll find a freshly repainted, open floor plan that's both inviting and functional. The UPDATED KITCHEN AND BATHROOMS are thoughtfully designed with modern finishes. The condo boasts abundant closet space, ensuring ample storage for all your needs. One of the highlights of this home is the private balcony, where you can take in stunning views of the city and Long Island Sound. Imagine waking up to BREATHTAKING SUNRISES and winding down with STUNNING SUNSETS from the comfort of your own home. Soundview Towers offers a wealth of amenities, including a 16-hour doorman, a well-appointed fitness center, laundry facilities on every floor, and a beautiful in-ground pool for relaxing on warm days. The unit also comes with a covered parking assigned spot for added convenience. Don't miss your chance to live in one of Stamford's most sought-after locations-schedule a viewing today!
